R代码：累积分布与概率密度

library(latex2exp)
layout(rbind(1:2,3:4))
opar<-par(las=1)
plot(xlim=c(-3.5,3.5),ylim=c(0,1.05),x<-seq(-3.5,3.5,1e-3),pnorm(x),type='p',xlab=TeX('$q=\\Phi^{-1}(p)$'),ylab=TeX('$p=\\Phi(q)$'),pch='.',col=ifelse(x<=1,grey(0.25),grey(0.75)))
abline(v=1,h=pnorm(1),lty=2,col='grey')
points(x=1,y=pnorm(1),pch=19,col='grey')

plot(xlim=c(-3.5,3.5),ylim=c(0,1.05),x<-seq(-3.5,3.5,1e-3),dnorm(x),type='h',col=ifelse(x<=1,grey(0.25),grey(0.75)),ylab='d: Φ(q)的导数',xlab='q')
text(-0,0.15,"p=84.13%",col=grey(.75),cex =1)


plot(xlim=c(-0.5,2.5),ylim=c(0,1.05),x<-seq(-0.5,2.5,1e-3),pbinom(q = x,prob = 0.5,size = 2),type='p',pch='.',ylab='p=CDF(q)',xlab=TeX('q=$CDF^{-1}(p)$=inf$\\{$ X | p ≤ $CDF(X)$$\\}$'))
abline(h=0.6,v=1,lty=2,col='grey')
points(x=1,y=0.6,pch=19,col='grey')

points(x<-0:2,pbinom(x,size = 2,prob = 0.5),pch=19)
points(x<-0:2,pbinom(x-1e-3,size = 2,prob = 0.5),pch=21)

x<-seq(0,1,1e-3);y <- qbinom(p = x,prob = 0.5,size = 2);
points(y,x,type='p',pch='.',col=grey(0.2+0.25*y))


plot(xlim=c(-0.5,2.5),ylim=c(0,1.05),x<-0:2,dbinom(x,prob = 0.5,size = 2),type='h',ylab='d: CDF(q)左极限落差',xlab='q',col=grey(0.2+0.25*x))
points(xlim=c(-0.5,2.5),ylim=c(0,1.05),x<-0:2,dbinom(x,prob = 0.5,size = 2),type='p',pch=19,col=grey(0.2+0.25*x))

lines(0:1,c(0.25,0),lty=2,col=grey(0.45))
lines(c(0,0),c(0.25,0.75),lty=2,col=grey(0.45))
lines(c(0,1),c(0.75,0.5),lty=2,col=grey(0.45))
lines(c(0,1),c(0.75,0.5),lty=2,col=grey(0.45))
lines(c(0,0),c(0.75,1),lty=2,col=grey(0.7))
lines(c(1,1),c(0.5,.75),lty=2,col=grey(0.7))
lines(c(0,1),c(1,.75),lty=2,col=grey(0.7))
lines(c(1,2),c(.5,.0),lty=2,col=grey(0.7))
lines(c(1,2),c(.75,.25),lty=2,col=grey(0.7))

高度\(\Leftrightarrow\)密度

set.seed(1)
x <- rnorm(n <- 3e4);y <- runif(n)
layout(cbind(1:2))
plot(xlim=c(-3.5,3.5),ylim=c(-1.05,1.05),
     x=c(x,x),y=c(y*dnorm(x),-y),
     pch=".",col=grey(0.75),ylab='visual density  d: Φ(q)的导数',xlab='q')
abline(h=0)

y1 <- x; y2 <- qnorm(y)
plot(xlim=c(-3.5,3.5),ylim=c(-3.5,3.5),
     y1,y2,
     col=grey(0.75),
     ylab=TeX('$Y_2$'),xlab=TeX('$Y_1$'),
     pch='.',
     asp=1) ## 确保纵、横坐标刻度单位比例锁定为1
abline(h=0,v=0,lty=2,col=grey(0.5))

layout(1)

二维标准正态伪随机向量

layout(rbind(1:2,3:4))
plot(xlim=c(-3.5,3.5),ylim=c(-3.5,3.5),
     y1,y2,
     col=grey(ifelse(y2<=1,0.25,0.75)),
     ylab=TeX('$Y_2$'),xlab=TeX('$Y_1$'),
     pch='.',main = TeX("Pr($Y_2$ ≤ 1)=84.13%"),
     asp=1) ## 确保纵、横坐标刻度单位比例锁定为1
abline(h=0,v=0,lty=2,col=grey(0.5))
abline(h=1,col=grey(0.25))

My <- (y1+y2)/2
plot(xlim=c(-3.5,3.5),ylim=c(-3.5,3.5),
     y1,y2,
     col=grey(ifelse(My  <= 1*(1/2)^.5,0.25,0.75)),
     xlab=TeX('$Y_1$'),
     ylab=TeX('$Y_2$'),
     pch='.',main = TeX("Pr($\\sqrt{2}\\bar{Y}$ ≤ 1)=84.13%"),
     asp=1) ## 确保纵、横坐标刻度单位比例锁定为1
abline(h=0,v=0,lty=2,col=grey(0.5))
abline(c(2^.5,-1),col=grey(0.25))


plot(xlim=c(-3.5,3.5),ylim=c(-3.5,3.5),
     x=y1*cos(th <- 45/180*pi)+y2*sin(th),
     y=y1*-sin(th)+y2*cos(th),
     col=grey(ifelse(y2<=1,0.25,0.75)),
     xlab=TeX('cos(45°)$Y_1$+sin(45°)$Y_2$'),
     ylab=TeX('-sin(45°)$Y_1$+cos(45°)$Y_2$'),
     pch='.',main = TeX("Pr($Y_2$ ≤ 1)=84.13%"),
     asp=1) ## 确保纵、横坐标刻度单位比例锁定为1
abline(c(0,1),lty=2,col=grey(0.5))
abline(c(0,-1),lty=2,col=grey(0.5))
abline(c(2^.5,-1),col=grey(0.25))

plot(xlim=c(-3.5,3.5),ylim=c(-3.5,3.5),
     x=y1*cos(th <- 45/180*pi)+y2*sin(th),
     y=y1*-sin(th)+y2*cos(th),
     col=grey(ifelse(My  <= 1*(1/2)^.5,0.25,0.75)),
     xlab=TeX('cos(45°)$Y_1$+sin(45°)$Y_2$'),
     ylab=TeX('-sin(45°)$Y_1$+cos(45°)$Y_2$'),
     pch='.',main = TeX("Pr($\\sqrt{2}\\bar{Y}$ ≤ 1)=84.13%"),
     asp=1) ## 确保纵、横坐标刻度单位比例锁定为1
abline(c(0,1),lty=2,col=grey(0.5))
abline(c(0,-1),lty=2,col=grey(0.5))
abline(v=1,col=grey(0.25))

layout(1)

两个独立的t分布坐标轴

dfs <- c(1,2,3,4)
layout(rbind(1:2,3:4))
for (df in dfs){
  y1 <- rt(n,df);y2 <-rt(n,df); 
  m <- qt(1-5e-3,df)
  plot(x=y1,
       y=y2,
       main=paste("df =",df),
       xlim = c(-m,m),ylim = c(-m,m),
       pch='.',col=grey(.75),asp=1)
  abline(h=0,v=0,lty=2,col=grey(0.5))
  abline(c(0,1),lty=2,col=grey(0.5))
}

layout(1)
